title: Prawn / Shrimp Cocktail
description: A classic Continental appetizer featuring perfectly poached prawns served with crisp lettuce and a creamy Marie Rose sauce. Elegant, refreshing, and ideal for fine dining presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Prawns
items: Large prawns / shrimp (peeled & deveined, tails on) – 400 g

ingredients.title: For the Marie Rose Sauce (Cocktail Sauce)
items: Hot sauce (Tabasco or similar) – a few drops
Brandy or Cognac (optional, for authentic Continental style) – 1 tsp

ingredients.title: For Assembly
items: Fresh dill or parsley – for garnish

instruction.title: Step 1 – Poach the Prawns
steps: In a pot, bring water, lemon slices, bay leaf, peppercorns, and salt to a gentle simmer.
Add prawns and cook for 2–3 minutes until just pink and firm.
Immediately transfer to ice water to stop cooking.
Pat dry and refrigerate until assembly.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare Marie Rose Sauce
steps: Combine mayonnaise, ketchup, Worcestershire, lemon juice, hot sauce, brandy (if using), paprika, salt, and white pepper.
Mix until smooth and keep chilled.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble (Presentation Options)
steps: Option A – Classic Glass Presentation: Place shredded lettuce at the base of a martini glass or coupe.
Arrange prawns around the rim with tails facing outward.
Top with more sauce and garnish with dill & a lemon wedge.
Option B – Modern Plated Version: Spread lettuce in a neat circular mold.
Toss prawns lightly in sauce and stack elegantly on top.
Add cucumber, cherry tomatoes, microgreens & a drizzle of extra sauce around the base.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve well chilled in martini glasses or on chilled appetizer plates.
Accompany with lemon wedges for extra freshness.
Ideal as a fine dining starter or seafood appetizer.

chefTips: Don't overcook the prawns — texture is key.
Use chilled plates/glasses for perfect serving temperature.
A tiny dash of horseradish in the sauce adds gourmet depth.
Upgrade with caviar or avocado slices for a luxury twist.
